cameraNeeded: Camera access is needed to take a photo.
cameraOff: Camera access is off. Enable it in the Settings app.

fromLibrary.note: Pick a picture from the photo library instead of taking one.

attached.note: VoiceOver label of the full-screen photo.

hold.message: Lay the receipt flat and hold still
hold.note: Status over the camera while it waits to read a receipt.

failed.note: error is a short reason, possibly from the system.

lightTip.note: Added after the status, after " · ", once several tries have failed. Lowercase.

receipt.cameraNeeded: Camera access is needed to photograph the receipt.
